_about: Documented-shape fixtures for the Google Places API (New) adapter (ADR-118, slice F1), derived from Google's published REST references for places:searchText and places.get and from the google.rpc.Status error model, as read through web-search results on 2026-10-23 (PLACES_CHECKED_ON in src/server/adapters/places/google-places.ts). Business names, phone numbers, place IDs, project numbers and URLs are fictitious. None of these is recorded live traffic; every shape is UNVERIFIED until a user-authorized live check (docs/integrations.md).
